from PIL import Image
from pathlib import Path
frames=sorted(Path('/Users/a123/.openclaw/workspace-research/outputs/video_quicklook').glob('frame_*.jpg'))
contact=[]
thumb_w=320
margin=10
rows=[]
for i in range(0,len(frames),2):
    rows.append(frames[i:i+2])
imgs=[]
for row in rows:
    row_imgs=[]
    for f in row:
        img=Image.open(f).convert('RGB')
        w,h=img.size
        new_h=int(h*thumb_w/w)
        row_imgs.append(img.resize((thumb_w,new_h)))
    imgs.append(row_imgs)
width=max(sum(im.size[0] for im in row)+margin*(len(row)-1) for row in imgs)
height=sum(max(im.size[1] for im in row) for row in imgs)+margin*(len(imgs)-1)
canvas=Image.new('RGB',(width,height),(255,255,255))
y=0
for row in imgs:
    x=0
    rh=max(im.size[1] for im in row)
    for im in row:
        canvas.paste(im,(x,y))
        x+=im.size[0]+margin
    y+=rh+margin
out='/Users/a123/.openclaw/workspace-research/outputs/video_quicklook/contact_sheet.jpg'
canvas.save(out,quality=90)
print(out)
PY
